description: Groups whose heroes, cards and creatures are organised into divisions, one folder level between the group and the hero. The same tree is used in every layer: data/art/heroes/<group>/<division>/<slug>.json, data/art/_sets/<group>/<division>/<slug>/..., prompts/<group>/<division>/<Hero>/..., and the ComfyUI output folders and workflow lists. A group that is not listed here has no divisions (drakn-sisters, drakn-bound, elder-dragons ...). The names follow the Sovereign Dawn card categories (data/cards/sovereign-dawn: heroes split by sex into female and male, then pets, units, buildings, equipment, tactics, workers); dragons are left out because the Elder Dragons have their own group. `alpha` is not a card category: it holds two generic test heroes (alpha/female, alpha/male) for trying other photos before giving one to an angel. Add a division here before you create its first card.
